{{Quote|And, by the way, thanks for the ''ship''.|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cade Bane]], to [[Sülphurr Cyander]]|<ref name="Spices & Spies">{{TCWComicCite|6.15|Spices & Spies}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sülphurr Cyander]] owned an '''R-41 Starchaser'''. The [[R-41 Starchaser|ship]] was eventually [[Skirmish in Mos Espa|stolen]] by rival bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].
